articles.body: Missouri’s Supreme Court suspended a congressional map that state Republicans drew last year that would have netted the GOP an additional House seat, likely keeping the seat in Democratic hands this November. The court ruled unanimously on Thursday that a referendum petition organized by Democrats to put the new congressional maps to a vote was incorrectly deemed insufficient by Republican Secretary of State Denny Hoskins, and ordered that the gerrymandered map be put to a vote in the fall. Voters will ultimately decide the fate of the new lines in November. But in the meantime, it cannot be in place for the midterms, meaning Rep. Emanuel Cleaver’s original Kansas City-based district will likely stay in Democrats’ hands this fall. "The congressional districts the General Assembly established in 2022 remain in full force and effect for the November 2026 general election, and HB 1 will not take effect unless and until approved by the voters at the November 2026 general election," Judge Ginger K. Gooch wrote in the court’s 7-0 opinion. The surprising decision creates an unprecedented set of electoral circumstances for Missouri voters and election administrators. The state's primaries took place under the new lines while Hoskins delayed a decision on the referendum, but the general election will now rely on the previous maps. President Donald Trump was quick to condemn the decision, which could help determine whether Democrats can take control of the House in the midterms and put a check on his agenda. "The Election Process, as usual, is being disturbed in America! " he wrote in a post on Truth Social . "Missouri must be able to use the map that was in effect just a couple of months ago, in the Primary. This is a Dark Day for “Justice” in Missouri!" For months, Missouri Republicans had signaled their intention to delay a ruling on Democrats’ referendum petition as long as possible while implementing the new maps in the primaries. Hoskins waited to declare the referendum insufficient on the day of the primaries last month. Republicans argued during hearings this week that changing the congressional lines months before an election could cause chaos. Missouri Attorney General Catherine Hanaway said in a social media post she will ask the U.S. Supreme Court to weigh in on the decision. Republicans across the country kicked off an unprecedented mid-decade redistricting gambit in 2025, starting with Texas, that has seen 10 states enact new maps. The Supreme Court’s decision gutting the Voting Rights Act, coupled with the Virginia Supreme Court striking down Democrats’ voter-approved gerrymander there, gave Republicans an edge of up to 10 seats. But as Americans continue to sour on Trump and Republicans, it’s unlikely the GOP will notch as many wins as they first hoped, though they still have an overall advantage from the redistricting. November’s referendum marks an early frontier in the looming 2028 redistricting battle, as leaders in both parties have signaled their intent to press for new lines to be drawn in favorable states. Both parties have already poured millions into Missouri’s redistricting fight. People Not Politicians, the Democratic group organizing the referendum, celebrated the court’s decision. "This is what democracy looks like, the people of Missouri demanded a voice, and the court just confirmed what we’ve been saying all along. People, not politicians, will have the final say,” Richard von Glahn, executive director of the group, said in a statement. “This victory reaches beyond Missouri. In a year when map-drawing has become a national weapon, courts across the country are watching what happens here.”
articles.headline: Missouri Supreme Court pauses GOP gerrymander, likely netting Democrats 1 House seat

articles.body: Construction crews could begin the excavation process for what will be President Donald Trump’s massive 250-foot-tall arch in as soon as the next two weeks, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced on Thursday. The monument — which will be erected in a traffic circle at the head of the Memorial Bridge over the Potomac River, coming between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington Cemetery — has generated controversy as concerns emerged about the design and traffic congestion during construction . The arch would take two to three years to construct on the proposed schedule, according to documents released in June. “We are pleased to announce that after a very long wait (over 125 years!), we are preparing to start, over the next two-week period, the excavation work necessary for the Great Triumphal Arch and Military Observation Deck,” Burgum said in a social media post . The 250-foot-tall arch will be among Trump's most visible projects, as the administration continues its attempts to remake Washington . Critics, however, have voiced fears that the structure may be too large, and overshadow other monuments, like the Lincoln Memorial on the other side of the Potomac River. The proposed arch will dwarf the Arc de Triomphe in Paris in size. It is unclear at this time how much construction will cost; the National Endowment for the Humanities earmarked $15 million for the monument. “This will be one the the Great Pieces of American Architecture, honoring the history and significance of Arlington National Cemetery and befitting the most powerful Capital in the World,” Burgum said. The monument will be constructed on land overseen by the National Park Service, and critics have argued Trump’s latest project requires explicit congressional approval. However, the Interior secretary continues to rebut these claims. Instead, Burgum echoed previous statements and said historically “Congress and various congressionally chartered commissions decreed that a monumental work should adorn Columbia Island,” the traffic circle where the monument is planned to be constructed. “Despite Congress’s intent, the site became and remains today a barren traffic circle lacking any monumental treatment and significant historic value,” he said.
articles.headline: Groundbreaking for Trump's arch will begin soon, Burgum says

articles.body: Former Vice President Kamala Harris is revving up her involvement in the midterms. While some Democrats are eager to embrace her, others want her to steer clear. Harris is planning to attend a canvass launch with Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford for his gubernatorial bid next month in Las Vegas, his campaign told POLITICO. “As anyone who is interested in 2028 should do, Kamala Harris will be coming through. We are a pivotal state in the presidential election,” Ford said in an interview in Las Vegas on Tuesday. “2028 starts right now in 2026.” Harris’ plans to visit Nevada signal yet another step into the fray of the midterms — and the national political stage. On Tuesday, she publicly backed Rep. Chris Pappas in his Senate bid in New Hampshire, a must-hold seat for the party in a state that Harris narrowly won in 2024. And she waded into three House races, two Democratic-leaning districts in her home state and a solidly Republican one in Tennessee . Harris had kept a relatively low profile so far on the campaign trail. Some Democrats prefer it that way. Iowa’s two most prominent Democratic candidates have said they do not want Harris to campaign for them. Alaska’s Democratic Senate nominee rejected a fundraising solicitation Harris sent on her behalf. And a swing-district Democrat in Wisconsin and a long-shot Senate hopeful in Kansas both told POLITICO they would prefer Harris keep her distance. “I received 9,000 more votes than Harris in 2024,” Rebecca Cooke, the Democratic challenger to Republican Rep. Derrick Van Orden in western Wisconsin, said in a statement when asked by POLITICO. “I don’t need anyone to come and campaign with me in my district. I do the work of building relationships — including across the aisle — on my own.” The arm’s-length treatment isn’t necessarily surprising: red-state and rural Democrats have long been hesitant to tie themselves to national Democratic figures. They are increasingly distancing themselves now as polls show the Democratic brand remains underwater even as President Donald Trump’s own standing with voters continues to drop. Trump’s approval hit a weak 36 percent in a recent poll conducted by The Economic and YouGov , while a separate survey from the pollster showed over 56 percent of registered voters disapproved of the Democratic Party. Harris’ favorability numbers at the end of last year only stood at 42 percent . As the party’s most recent presidential nominee, she is one of its most prominent avatars. A Cooke campaign aide, granted anonymity to discuss internal conversations, said Cooke’s team has turned down campaign offers from other national Democrats as she focuses on making a personal case to voters in one of the party’s top target districts this fall. Cooke hasn’t warded off everyone, however: During her primary she leaned heavily into support from Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.), featuring him in campaign ads; his team also sent texts to help turn out voters. She also has accepted endorsements from potential 2028 candidates like former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg and Sens. Mark Kelly (D-Ariz.) and Elissa Slotkin (D-Mich.). Other high-profile Democrats, like California Gov. Gavin Newsom , have similarly stayed relatively low-key with their own endorsements so far. He’s faced some Democratic distancing himself: Stefany Shaheen, who is running for a House seat in New Hampshire, emphasized her support from Granite Staters when asked about a fundraising email the governor sent on her behalf last month. Harris, like other potential presidential candidates, needs to build a network of friends and favors — much of which she has already developed from her own runs for Senate, the White House and her four years as vice president — while staying relevant. She retains a powerful fundraising network that can help down-ticket Democrats, too. But in many parts of the country where she lost, her involvement could be a drag for Democrats otherwise facing strong political tailwinds in the midterms. “It’s all good,” Eduardo Negrón, a spokesperson for Harris, said in a statement. “Vice President Harris will continue to raise money and travel on behalf of candidates in races where she can help make a difference. With Trump so unpopular and our deep bench of strong candidates, we are now seeing deeply red states in play this cycle. The Vice President believes we should be ruthless about competing everywhere and that means giving candidates in tough races the space to do whatever it takes to win.” Harris’ recent ramp-up marks a shift from what had been an otherwise quiet midterms strategy that has focused primarily on standing by close preexisting relationships . It’s strikingly different from other potential 2028 presidential candidates who’ve endorsed more widely and been more prominent on the campaign trail. One of the few times she did weigh into a contested primary was for Rep. Jasmine Crockett (D-Texas) — a co-chair of her 2024 presidential campaign — in her bid for Texas Senate. The vice president’s support came in the form of a robo-call released just days before the primary rather than an in-person appearance, and she quickly backed James Talarico shortly after he won the nomination. She also threw her support behind Michigan Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed after a bruising primary that has left Democrats scrambling to project unity heading into the general election. Red-state Democrats have been particularly pointed in their calls to keep Harris out of their races. “In Kansas, you're trying to reach 45 percent of the state who are Republicans and a lot of really good people who are Republicans, but their vantage point or their worldview may be a bit different than Kamala Harris',” Kansas Democratic Senate nominee Adam Hamilton told POLITICO. “What I'm looking at is I'm really mounting a very Kansas-centered campaign, and I'm out speaking, I tell people I'm running as an independent-minded Democrat.” Hamilton is running an uphill battle in a state that hasn’t sent a Democrat to the Senate since 1932 . The state is seen as potentially somewhat in play amid the ongoing war in Iran, trade wars with close allies and a persistent cost of living crisis that have cut especially deep in agricultural territory. But that doesn’t mean a coastal Democrat like Harris would play well in the conservative heartland. “Having somebody from California come in and try to tell Kansans who they should vote for is a pretty bad idea,” Hamilton said. Harris has not endorsed in the race. Other Democrats have taken similar tones toward Harris in recent days. In an interview with POLITICO , Iowa State Auditor Rob Sand said he would not want the former vice president to appear with him as he runs for governor, adding that the country needed “new leadership.” State Rep. Josh Turek, speaking with reporters after an event for his Senate campaign in Cedar Rapids, broadcasted an even more blunt answer to the same question: “No,” he said flatly, letting out a laugh. A similar scenario played out in Alaska last month. After Harris’ team sent a fundraising email for Senate candidate and former Rep. Mary Peltola (D-Alaska) on the eve of the state’s primary election, a spokesperson for Peltola’s campaign told a local Alaska television station that she “isn’t seeking endorsements from anyone from the Lower 48.” Peltola’s campaign did not respond to POLITICO’s questions on the matter. Campaign spokespeople for several battleground Senate Democrats locked in high-profile races, including El-Sayed in Michigan, Troy Jackson in Maine and Roy Cooper in North Carolina — who have all received her support — declined to respond to requests for comment about how involved they would like the former vice president to be in their races. Harris’ support isn’t an albatross for all Democrats, however. For some, her endorsement is welcome — and they want her out on the trail. One key battleground Democrat (and a potential 2028 rival), Georgia Sen. Jon Ossoff, embraced Harris’ support with open arms. “Senator Ossoff is grateful for Vice President Harris' help and support in his re-election campaign,” campaign spokesperson Ellie Dougherty said in a statement, adding that he would welcome her to Georgia to campaign alongside him or on his behalf. Harris lost Georgia, but the rightward swing in the state was the smallest of any battleground — in large part because of a population boom in metro Atlanta and the large share of Black voters. And in deep-blue Massachusetts, former Biden White House aide Dan Koh won an open House primary on Tuesday after running aggressively on support from Harris and President Joe Biden. Koh sought their support and featured them prominently in a campaign ad and in social media videos. He said scheduling didn’t work out for them to hit the trail, though. “I will never run away from two people I admire greatly, who I believe did a lot of good for this country,” Koh said last week. Jessica Piper contributed to this report.
articles.headline: Kamala Harris wants back in the fight. These Democrats don’t want her help.

articles.body: Sports broadcaster Stephen A. Smith has been bouncing around cable TV but insists he’s staying out of one arena: the political one. The outspoken ESPN and SiriusXM personality isn’t staying away from talking politics — far from it. But Smith told POLITICO in an interview airing Thursday that he’s not running for president in 2028 in his firmest rejection yet of speculation that has surrounded him for the past year. “The minute I announce that I’m running, I would be taken off the air,” Smith said in an interview on The Conversation with Dasha Burns. “I wouldn't be able to work, and I would lose a contract that I worked my entire career for, you know, and I'm not giving that up.” He left no wiggle room: “As long as the rules are what they are and they can’t be circumvented, it’s not something that I’m going to think about." That didn’t mean Smith, who is famous for his brash takes, didn’t have a few about Democrats and Republicans. Smith, who has repeatedly doled out criticism of both parties, offered blunt advice for Democrats seeking a path back to power: Purge the Democratic Socialists of America and restrain the party’s progressive flank. The Democrats, he said, should only welcome people who “march lockstep” with the party. “We should never want to hear anything about the Democratic Party being a ‘big tent,’” he said. Asked how Democrats should handle the progressives, Smith said: “Tell them to sit their ass down and get with the program.” He also warned that Democrats’ association with left-wing streamer Hasan Piker would “come back to haunt” the party. Smith said he would have Piker on his SiriusXM political show “if necessary,” and then “grill him about the things that he said and why.” Smith’s remarks come as Democrats have been distancing themselves from Piker, who played an active role in supporting Abdul El-Sayed for Senate in Michigan and has come under fire for commentary that has included suggesting that American Jewish support for Israel could lead someone to “take action” against Jews in the U.S. The ESPN and SiriusXM star also had some praise for President Donald Trump, crediting him for recognizing “that most voters believe our politics and our politicians are full of shit” in a way that Democrats have been unable to articulate as well. “He speaks a language that the electorate, no matter who they are or what side of the aisle they are on, can relate to, even if they despise him,” Smith said, adding that there are millions of voters out there who “want chaos” and “the evisceration of rules and decorum and regulations.” Looking ahead to 2028, Smith named Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro as his top prospect for Democrats, calling him “big time,” and saying “[his] record is head and shoulders above anybody right now.” Smith also praised Maryland Gov. Wes Moore, but thinks electing him could be a challenge following Barack Obama’s presidency. On the Republican side, Smith dismissed a potential run by media personality Tucker Carlson, noting he doesn’t think the former Fox host could secure enough support from independents. On the other hand, Smith argued that Secretary of State Marco Rubio would be a stronger candidate than Vice President JD Vance. Vance is “an individual that tries to be too like Trump,” Smith told POLITICO. “And I don't think there's — the level of authenticity that you're wishing to see from candidates; I don't think he's that guy. I think that Marco Rubio is an authentic individual.” Smith even noted he would consider voting for Rubio himself, saying it depends “on the candidate on the left.” Watch the whole interview on the latest episode of “The Conversation.”
articles.headline: Stephen A. Smith has some words for Democrats as he makes his 2028 plans clear

articles.body: President Donald Trump has invited a group of GOP lawmakers including Republicans in competitive races to dine with him Wednesday night at the White House as many in the party press the president to unleash his massive war chest ahead of the November elections, according to five people with direct knowledge of the matter. They, like others, were granted anonymity to discuss private planning. Wisconsin Rep. Derrick Van Orden confirmed the event in a brief interview with POLITICO. “Of course,” Van Orden said when asked if he would go to the dinner.The White House plans to hold the dinner in the Rose Garden, according to two of the people who know about the invitation. Other House Republicans in tough races who were invited and plan to attend include Rep. Tom Barrett (R-Mich.) and Georgia Senate nominee Rep. Mike Collins, along with a wider group of GOP lawmakers. The White House invited at least several dozen lawmakers, according to two people familiar with the invitation list. The dinner also comes ahead of next week’s GOP midterm convention in Dallas, though attendance from Republican lawmakers is expected to be mixed . Barrett, for example, said in an interview Tuesday he is not planning to attend the convention and will instead campaign and spend time with his family. A White House spokesperson did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Republicans are facing mounting electoral headwinds from the war in Iran, higher gas prices and new tariffs as they fight to hold onto their narrow congressional majorities in November. GOP incumbents are also eager for new infusions of resources to help dull Democrats’ attacks over voters’ cost-of-living concerns. Speaker Mike Johnson recently met with GOP megadonor Elon Musk , who has said he will spend millions to back the GOP again this cycle. Trump’s political operation, MAGA Inc., has used little of its $400 million war chest to support GOP lawmakers. But he recently helped boost Sen. Darline Graham over the line in her heated primary, with the group spending more than $800,000 on phone calls and texts for the political newcomer. Senate Republicans are eager for Trump to start spending for Ken Paxton in Texas as he has thus far been outspent on the airwaves by Democrat James Talarico and his allies. The scheduled dinner comes the same day Securing American Greatness, the nonprofit arm of Trump’s operation, is launching its first major ad buy of the general election. One ad features UFC President Dana White praising Trump along with a clip from Trump’s State of the Union address in February. Another ad touts the tax cuts passed through Republicans' domestic agenda bill last year, including “no tax on tips.” The ads are part of a nearly $1 million national TV reservation running over the next two weeks, per data tracking firm AdImpact.Both ads come as Trump advisers are reportedly planning to use his political organization to try and boost the president's approval ahead of the midterms. Erin Doherty, Aaron Pellish and Andrew Howard contributed reporting to this article.
articles.headline: Trump invites battleground Republicans to Rose Garden dinner

articles.body: LAS VEGAS — Vice President JD Vance tried to make inroads with Jewish Republicans. Not everyone is sold. Vance’s closed-door speech at the Republican Jewish Coalition’s annual leadership summit Monday night went a long way in alleviating top pro-Israel donors’ concerns about his support for the U.S.-Israeli relationship, and it cemented their view that Vance would be a preferable choice to whomever the Democratic Party nominee is in 2028. But some attendees still have questions for Vance — particularly around his relationship with conservative pundit Tucker Carlson, who has long drawn ire from the Republican Jewish leaders for his criticism of Israel and outraged many when he hosted the antisemite Nick Fuentes for a lengthy podcast interview last year. "He allayed a lot of concern, but he failed to address his relationship with Tucker Carlson, and that left a lot of people wondering why,” said Josh Katzen, a real estate developer and member of the RJC board, speaking in his personal capacity. Vance, the current front-runner for the Republican nomination in 2028, has long faced skepticism from Jewish Republicans who question his commitment to the U.S.-Israeli relationship and his response to antisemitism within the GOP. In his speech Monday, he took both issues head-on, and largely appeased the skeptical crowd with his answers, declaring that “Jew-hatred is corrosive to the soul” and saying Republicans need to articulate to young Americans why an alliance with Israel is in the best interest of the U.S. But his meandering response to a question about Carlson and other podcasters left some in attendance yearning for more. “A few names: Tucker Carlson, Megyn Kelly, Joe Rogan, Nick Fuentes. They have platformed antisemites,” former Sen. Norm Coleman (R-Minn.), the RJC’s board chair, asked Vance. “How do you draw the line, in terms of … the platforms that you appear on? “I recognize a lot of people in this room may disagree with things that Tucker Carlson or Megyn Kelly or Joe Rogan have said,” Vance said, before pivoting to discuss Rogan and Fuentes, saying those are “two very, very different categories of people” and suggesting people like Rogan should be reasoned with, even when there are disagreements. The answer was not sufficient to some, who wonder about his longtime relationship with Carlson. Vance was a regular on Carlson’s Fox News show and credited Carlson for helping carry him to victory in his 2022 U.S. Senate primary in Ohio. In 2024, Carlson pushed for Trump to pick Vance as his running mate. “JD Vance allying himself with an individual who has called for Trump's immediate removal from office will make it harder for many of us Jewish conservatives to consider his candidacy,” said Shabbos Kestenbaum, a pro-Israel campus activist who spoke at the Republican National Convention in 2024 and spoke at last year’s RJC conference. “We hope this issue is resolved quickly so we can focus on policy, not personality.” Eric Levine, a major GOP donor and member of the RJC board, said Vance could’ve had “an incredible Sister Souljah moment” if he took on Carlson. “In my view, on the issue of Jews and Israel, there is no difference between Hasan Piker, Zohran Mamdani, Abdul El-Sayed and the DSA writ large on the one hand and Tucker Carlson, Nick Fuentes, Marjorie Taylor Green and neo-Nazis on the other hand,” said Levine, speaking in his personal capacity. “That is why I wish the vice president had unambiguously separated himself and condemned Tucker by name.” Conservative radio host Sid Rosenberg also wasn’t satisfied. Just hours after urging RJC attendees in a speech onstage to “give Vance a chance,” he was critical of how Vance handled that opportunity. “He had a chance to hammer @TuckerCarlson and @megynkelly but instead spent all his time defending @joerogan over Nick Fuentes,” Rosenberg wrote on X . “Look, he’s still better than any Democrat candidate but I don’t think he wowed the STRONG Jews in the room tonight.” Carlson, in a text message, said, “An organization that promotes and defends genocide is continuing to insist that they’re the real victims? I can’t imagine who buys this nonsense anymore.” Human rights groups have accused Israel of genocide over its conduct in the war in Gaza, which the country's leaders vehemently deny. Vance’s office did not respond to a request for comment for this story. An individual close to Vance, granted anonymity to describe sentiment within the vice president’s orbit, said there was no illusion Vance would win over every person in attendance, “or that every single person would love every single answer.” “The goal was to lower the temperature, extend an olive branch, and make clear that the vice president is an ally, not an enemy,” the person said, arguing that goal was “achieved.” Sam Markstein, spokesperson for the RJC, emphasized that the organization is a coalition. “There will always be many opinions within the organization,” Markstein said. “In an hour when too many public figures are walking away from the Jewish community and the U.S.-Israel relationship, the Republican Jewish Coalition will always stand with the leaders who show up. Vice President JD Vance shows up — and received multiple standing ovations with thunderous applause.” Vance, who was elected to the Senate in 2022, faces a fundamental disadvantage among potential Republican 2028ers: He’s still a relative newcomer to the Republican political scene. Others, like Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Sen. Ted Cruz (R-Texas), have developed relationships with pro-Israel Republicans in both the Jewish and evangelical Christian communities for years, going well back before their respective 2016 presidential runs. Rubio has pushed to revoke visas from individuals accused of promoting antisemitism or supporting terrorism. Cruz has publicly sparred with Carlson , criticizing him of antisemitism. A Cruz-aligned nonprofit recently launched to take on right-wing antisemitism. Vance’s speech was his first at an RJC leadership summit, though he attended in 2022. It was the first time since 2019 a sitting president or vice president attended the conference, which draws some of the country’s most influential Republican donors. Not being a favorite among RJC leaders wasn’t an impediment to Donald Trump’s political outsider 2016 presidential bid. During that campaign, he was accused of invoking antisemitic stereotypes during a speech to the RJC and in a social media post . But upon taking office, he formed a strong relationship with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, culminating in the Abraham Accords and moving the U.S. embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. Speakers at the RJC’s two-day summit this week frequently referred to Trump as the most pro-Israel president in U.S. history. But Rubio and Cruz have been fixtures at past iterations of the RJC’s annual leadership summit, and they maintain strong ties with the group’s leadership. (None have announced whether they’ll seek the presidential nomination, though Rubio has stated he will not run if Vance does.) Many attendees said Rubio is still the favorite amongst the crowd. “Every time Marco Rubio's name is mentioned in this conference, there's a spontaneous round of applause,” said Katzen, the RJC board member. Indeed, when Rosenberg urged attendees to welcome Vance in a speech Monday, he mentioned the hypothetical, “If Marco Rubio was here tonight—” and was drowned out by applause. Should Rubio not run for the nomination against Vance, other observers think Cruz will have the inside lane among the RJC crowd. "Ted Cruz is loved here, and he deserves to be loved here,” said Levine, prior to Vance’s speech. “Look, if it's Cruz and Vance, I expect that this crowd would be 90 percent Cruz." Ari Fleischer, an RJC board member and a former White House press secretary, said Vance made inroads — but building a relationship with the pro-Israel community takes time. "It's fair to say hearts and minds are changing, but I think it's also fair to say that when you come before the Republican Jewish Coalition, it's like when you come to New Hampshire to campaign,” Fleischer said. “After the third or fourth time, we let you know how you're doing.”

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/RTB4SJDKSVFLTGBD2IC2RKJPRA.jpg?auth=ff5f74e0506408962f2926466bf40d1bf5c46c1832e41a5e99b25f2e43531bc8" width="6000" height="4000" alt="Un cartel avisa de que un centro de acogida de migrantes en Ceuta está saturado."></img><p>El cartel de la verja de entrada reza “no hay sitio”, en castellano y en árabe, pero da igual. Decenas de mujeres marroquíes llevan horas instaladas en las aceras esperando a que la realidad y el cartel cambien, cosa que no sucederá. Porque dentro la situación está al límite. En las carpas que acogen desde hace semanas a las más de 250 mujeres y niños en el barrio de Sidi Embarek, en Ceuta, han llegado a un punto de no retorno. “Tal y como están las cosas, mañana nos quedamos sin comida”, dice Uzman Bersabé, del Movimiento Social y Vecinal de Ceuta, una de las organizaciones que lleva ya más de un mes ocupándose solidaria y voluntariamente de las migrantes más vulnerables. Primero, en <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-09/situacion-critica-de-las-menores-en-ceuta-violencia-sexual-y-refugiadas-con-sus-nuevas-madres.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-09/situacion-critica-de-las-menores-en-ceuta-violencia-sexual-y-refugiadas-con-sus-nuevas-madres.html">un precario campo de fútbol que se desbordó</a>, y ahora desde este espacio junto a la mezquita del barrio periférico, cuyo terreno ha cedido la ONG Luna Blanca para montar el campamento provisional. Pero “provisional” ha perdido su significado en esta ciudad. Porque la Delegación del Gobierno les aseguró que este asentamiento sería temporal, y realojarían a las migrantes en las instalaciones del Centro Ecuestre, conocido como La Hípica, pero no ha sucedido. “Trasladaron allí a las mujeres que estaban acogidas en otro campamento en El Príncipe, y se llevaron de aquí a los menores no acompañados, pero ya está. Quedan aquí 250 mujeres con sus hijos para los que ya no tienen sitio”, explica Uzman.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-04/ultimatum-a-la-solidaridad-en-ceuta-manana-no-habra-comida-para-250-mujeres-y-ninos.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/INNWQMHIVJFWVMCJCV277HXRFU.jpg?auth=e8b7309c511f913e05105799e630d392242bf3a492c0d716351283b1666fd53b" width="5557" height="3453" alt="Urinarios portátiles en el centro de acogida de migrantes."></img><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/HSHBTD653ZAY5FUVAYOLTT4PJI.jpg?auth=f4b93d2232813be46fa794393abafe629050eaa2ce497041ad2fe91a90ef60a2" width="6000" height="4000" alt="Mujeres y menores migrantes en un centro organizado por vecinos de Ceuta."></img>

Se utilizó <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-07/las-ong-de-marruecos-elevan-a-141-la-cifra-de-muertos-a-ambos-lados-de-la-frontera-de-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-07/las-ong-de-marruecos-elevan-a-141-la-cifra-de-muertos-a-ambos-lados-de-la-frontera-de-ceuta.html">la cifra de 141 muertos,</a> cuando igual hubo otros muchos más que fueron devorados por el mar y de los que no queda huella alguna. Quizá sea ese el lugar idóneo para abordar esta crisis, colocarse en la piel de quienes lo perdieron todo. Es verdad que son muchos los que, una y otra vez, se arriesgan y corren los mayores peligros para dejar atrás una situación insoportable, y consiguen cruzar esa frontera que va a colocarlos en otro mundo, al que identifican con la posibilidad de tener nuevas oportunidades y vivir mejor. Pero <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-02/los-tres-dias-de-horror-que-acorralaron-a-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-02/los-tres-dias-de-horror-que-acorralaron-a-ceuta.html">lo que ocurrió el 30 y el 31 de julio</a> fue distinto. No es lo mismo afrontar ese desafío en solitario, o en grupos reducidos, o de la mano de unas mafias que los arruinan para facilitarles las cosas. Lo que sucedió en esos días es que cuantos se pusieron en marcha hacia Ceuta lo hicieron protegidos o amparados o como parte de una masa que transmitía tanta fortaleza, seguridad y poder que, efectivamente, los condujo hacia el otro lado, hacia el territorio de los sueños y el futuro, sin demasiadas complicaciones. Las cifras siguen un poco en el aire, pero esa masa que cruzó la frontera la compusieron 72.000 personas u 80.000; se ha llegado a hablar incluso de unas 100.000.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-09-04/los-muertos-de-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Los muertos de Ceuta

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/S7EVXYQPIFDNHF2ADAM6ZOJAZU.jpg?auth=eb2eaffcb21201ceb91cdd561975e5c2d88b94ddfe6186014a97fdb98b2002e6" width="6000" height="4000" alt="Asistentes a la manifestación con motivo del Día de Ceuta en Madrid, convocada este miércoles ante todos los ayuntamientos de España."></img><p>Durante ocho años, el Partido Popular y Vox han intentado sacar a la gente a la calle por motivos de lo más variopintos, pero la crisis en Ceuta marca un punto de inflexión en las movilizaciones de la derecha. <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-02/feijoo-y-abascal-unen-fuerzas-en-la-protesta-por-ceuta-y-acusan-a-sanchez-de-mentir-a-los-espanoles-es-un-traidor.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-02/feijoo-y-abascal-unen-fuerzas-en-la-protesta-por-ceuta-y-acusan-a-sanchez-de-mentir-a-los-espanoles-es-un-traidor.html">La gente no protestó ayer</a> porque lo quisieran Alberto Núñez Feijóo o Santiago Abascal, sino al margen de ellos. Algo ha cambiado respecto a aquellos tiempos de salir en contra de la amnistía o del independentismo. Esta vez, la base social de la derecha se aunó por un sentimiento de pertenencia o comunitario, desde abajo, inclusivo.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-09-03/el-movimiento-por-ceuta-da-un-giro-en-la-derecha.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: El movimiento por Ceuta da un giro en la derecha

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/26RNMKNLXJHDHLALRUAEALIHPE.jpg?auth=9662f2ad66aafee33619361cd90400f38ac49a499e77ef721ab6df775439291a" width="3958" height="2663" alt="El presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, durante el pleno extraordinario en el que comparece para explicar sus decisiones en la crisis migratoria sufrida por Ceuta."></img><p>Reconozcamos una cosa antes de empezar. Esto de que la comparecencia de Pedro Sánchez en el Congreso de los Diputados <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/sanchez-si-existieran-pruebas-contra-marruecos-actuariamos-pero-no-hay-evidencias-solidas.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/sanchez-si-existieran-pruebas-contra-marruecos-actuariamos-pero-no-hay-evidencias-solidas.html">para hablar de Ceuta</a> era el asunto más importante del día es un poco mentira. Simplemente es algo que nos decimos unos cuantos en jornadas como las de este jueves, muchos menos que los casi cincuenta millones de personas que vivimos en España. Para darnos importancia ante nuestros entornos, para creernos que los focos están puestos en los que hablamos y escuchamos, en los que escribimos, en los que también escriben los discursos de los que salen al atril. Y porque forma parte de nuestro trabajo, tan igual y tan distinto como el del resto. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/otro-dia-historico-para-apenas-unos-cuantos.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Otro día histórico para apenas unos cuantos

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/GYCDPC4SJFHVPLSKIAUD2WIVF4.jpg?auth=034e954a2308ff41dc913627288e464673e44fb74662a03ee9d7fd42d1009499" width="3955" height="2225" alt="El presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, en el programa 'Hoy por hoy' de la Cadena SER, este lunes. "></img><p>La función principal de un Estado es garantizar la seguridad. Para ello debe controlar sus fronteras y mantener las condiciones que permiten que sus ciudadanos desarrollen su vida con normalidad. El Gobierno ha fracasado, y sigue fracasando, en esas funciones básicas en Ceuta. El Estado no ha servido para su razón de ser: ha desamparado a sus nacionales. Se suma, además, una crisis humanitaria, producto de la negligencia ante <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-30/ceuta-el-mes-que-rompio-una-ciudad.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-30/ceuta-el-mes-que-rompio-una-ciudad.html">la avalancha migratoria y la tardanza en la gestión de sus consecuencias.</a></p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-09-03/da-igual-lo-que-diga-pedro-sanchez.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Da igual lo que diga Pedro Sánchez

articles.body: <p>Un mes después del <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-30/ceuta-el-mes-que-rompio-una-ciudad.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-30/ceuta-el-mes-que-rompio-una-ciudad.html">asalto masivo a la frontera española,</a> Ceuta sigue desbordada. Desde el 31 de julio la ciudad autónoma está sufriendo una crisis humanitaria que ha deteriorado la seguridad y la convivencia en sus calles. <a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-08-24/ceuta-esta-vez-tiene-que-ser-la-ultima.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-08-24/ceuta-esta-vez-tiene-que-ser-la-ultima.html">Los ceutíes lo padecen</a> y, según innumerables testimonios en todos los medios de comunicación, se sienten abandonados. Los niños no van a los parques, y las mujeres desaparecen de las calles cuando cae la tarde. La ciudad no encuentra la normalidad que desea, y sus habitantes ignoran <a href="https://elpais.com/podcasts/hoy-en-el-pais/2026-08-31/ceuta-distintos-miedos-y-una-misma-sensacion-de-abandono-no-podemos-salir-sin-spray-pimienta-y-duermo-escondido-entre-las-canas.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/podcasts/hoy-en-el-pais/2026-08-31/ceuta-distintos-miedos-y-una-misma-sensacion-de-abandono-no-podemos-salir-sin-spray-pimienta-y-duermo-escondido-entre-las-canas.html">cuánto va a durar esta sensación</a> de inseguridad y de desorden.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/opinion/2026-09-03/ceuta-las-ninas-son-las-mas-vulnerables.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Ceuta: las niñas son las más vulnerables

articles.body: <p>El secretario general del PP, Miguel Tellado, ha calificado de “cínica” a la ministra de Defensa, Margarita Robles, por <a href="https://elpais.com/videos/2026-09-03/margarita-robles-evita-aplaudir-el-anuncio-de-sanchez-sobre-la-publicacion-de-los-informes-sobre-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/videos/2026-09-03/margarita-robles-evita-aplaudir-el-anuncio-de-sanchez-sobre-la-publicacion-de-los-informes-sobre-ceuta.html">la actitud que mantuvo el jueves en el Congreso de los Diputados</a> cuando el presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, informó de la publicación de u<a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/el-gobierno-anuncia-la-publicacion-de-un-dosier-con-todos-los-informes-previos-a-la-entrada-masiva-en-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/el-gobierno-anuncia-la-publicacion-de-un-dosier-con-todos-los-informes-previos-a-la-entrada-masiva-en-ceuta.html">n dosier con todos los informes de seguridad</a> previos la entrada masiva a Ceuta. Robles evitó aplaudir mientras toda la bancada de ministros ovacionaba el anuncio. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-04/tellado-carga-contra-robles-y-la-acusa-de-cinismo-por-su-actitud-en-el-congreso.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>La Guardia Civil ha informado este viernes de una operación que ha permitido interceptar <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-22/detenidas-diez-personas-tras-disparar-a-la-guardia-civil-durante-la-persecucion-de-una-narcolancha-en-la-costa-de-huelva.html" target="_blank" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-22/detenidas-diez-personas-tras-disparar-a-la-guardia-civil-durante-la-persecucion-de-una-narcolancha-en-la-costa-de-huelva.html">al sur de Gran Canaria una narcolancha que </a>transportaba 3.360 kilos de cocaína distribuidos en 139 fardos. La operación se ha saldado con la detención de sus cinco tripulantes, de entre 21 y 41 años, que llevaban a bordo un fusil de asalto y una ametralladora ligera, según el cuerpo armado.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-04/la-guardia-civil-se-incauta-de-mas-de-tres-toneladas-de-cocaina-en-una-narcolancha-al-sur-de-gran-canaria.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

"></img><p>“Ceuta se ha convertido en Gaza”, “Ceuta es ahora Gaza”. Cargadas de desmesura, también de tirón para captar atención digital, estas frases constituyen un mensaje esencial de la red proisraelí de canales Estrategias Militares, con 560.000 suscriptores en YouTube —donde sus vídeos se acercan a los 190 millones de visualizaciones—, 70.800 seguidores en X y casi 26.900 miembros de su lista de difusión de Telegram. La red, que emite en español pero tiene vinculaciones con el país israelí —de cuyas autoridades no recibe financiación, asegura Estrategias Militares—, se caracteriza por la integración en un maremágnum sensacionalista de dos discursos. ¿Cuáles? El primero, una narrativa abiertamente favorable al Gobierno de <a href="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-07-27/netanyahu-viaja-a-ee-uu-para-reunirse-con-trump-tras-los-encontronazos-mantenidos-sobre-la-guerra-en-iran.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-07-27/netanyahu-viaja-a-ee-uu-para-reunirse-con-trump-tras-los-encontronazos-mantenidos-sobre-la-guerra-en-iran.html">Benjamin Netanyahu</a>, sobre todo en relación con <a href="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-08-16/la-vida-en-gaza-un-infierno-cotidiano-tras-300-dias-de-alto-el-fuego.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-08-16/la-vida-en-gaza-un-infierno-cotidiano-tras-300-dias-de-alto-el-fuego.html">Gaza</a> e <a href="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-09-02/iran-responde-a-estados-unidos-con-nuevos-ataques-contra-bahrein-jordania-y-kuwait.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/internacional/2026-09-02/iran-responde-a-estados-unidos-con-nuevos-ataques-contra-bahrein-jordania-y-kuwait.html">Irán</a>; el segundo, un ataque frontal al Ejecutivo español por la <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/las-claves-del-informe-que-marlaska-no-conocia-y-que-puede-suponer-el-inicio-de-una-investigacion-por-lo-sucedido-en-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/las-claves-del-informe-que-marlaska-no-conocia-y-que-puede-suponer-el-inicio-de-una-investigacion-por-lo-sucedido-en-ceuta.html">crisis ceutí</a>, presentada como resultado de una acción de guerra de Marruecos facilitada por Pedro Sánchez.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-04/histeria-belica-y-desinformacion-en-una-red-digital-proisraeli-ceuta-es-ahora-gaza.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/P4DJAYCVJ5BATN5NNKD357H7UA.jpg?auth=ee1bf9b1da694ee80669f167fd3cce6a7840479fb9505abaf2e9ea387ab623a3" width="6000" height="4000" alt="Inmigrantes esperan el reparto de comida en playa Trampolín en Ceuta, este jueves. "></img>
articles.headline: Histeria bélica y desinformación en una red digital proisraelí: “Ceuta es ahora Gaza”

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/6KF2R2GFTBCLTJD5G2IX6OKSRU.jpg?auth=94aabdb3b0d93eb335e5cf067aedd4e5d4c4aca8a99cdb2e4abf8d9591feaadc" width="6000" height="2992" alt="Decenas de migrantes caminan por la playa del Trampolín, este jueves. "></img><p>El fiscal jefe de la Audiencia Nacional, Jesús Alonso, será el encargado de redactar el informe que el ministerio público tiene que entregar a la jueza María Tardón antes de que esta decida si abre o no una investigación sobre la entrada masiva de migrantes a Ceuta los días 30 y 31 de julio. Fuentes fiscales han precisado que Alonso asumirá esta responsabilidad, que hasta ahora estaba en manos del fiscal José Perals, dada la “singularidad y trascendencia” del asunto. El fiscal Perals ya había comunicado a su jefe su criterio favorable a que se iniciara una causa por seguridad nacional <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-02/el-informe-de-la-policia-apunta-que-agentes-marroquies-guiaron-la-entrada-de-migrantes-a-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-02/el-informe-de-la-policia-apunta-que-agentes-marroquies-guiaron-la-entrada-de-migrantes-a-ceuta.html">a raíz del informe presentado por la Policía que indica que gendarmes marroquíes “guiaron” a miles de personas a la frontera española.</a></p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/el-jefe-de-la-fiscalia-de-la-audiencia-nacional-asume-el-tema-de-ceuta-por-la-trascendencia.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: El jefe de la Fiscalía de la Audiencia Nacional asume el tema de Ceuta por la “trascendencia”

articles.body: <p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/las-claves-del-informe-que-marlaska-no-conocia-y-que-puede-suponer-el-inicio-de-una-investigacion-por-lo-sucedido-en-ceuta.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/las-claves-del-informe-que-marlaska-no-conocia-y-que-puede-suponer-el-inicio-de-una-investigacion-por-lo-sucedido-en-ceuta.html">El informe que la Policía ha entregado a la Audiencia Nacional sobre la entrada masiva a Ceuta</a> ―en el que se apunta que agentes marroquíes “guiaron” a los migrantes en el cruce de la frontera― sigue sacudiendo al cuerpo. El malestar en el Ministerio del Interior ha llevado al ministro Fernando Grande-Marlaska a enviar un escrito a la presidenta del Consejo General del Poder Judicial (CGPJ), Isabel Perelló, en el que transmite su “preocupación” por el hecho de que la jueza María Tardón prohibiera al equipo policial al que encargó el informe que facilitase información a sus superiores. Perelló le ha contestado con otra carta, en la que ha respaldado la actuación de Tardón y le ha recordado al ministro que cuando un juez pide auxilio a cualquier equipo policial, este tiene el deber constitucional de prestar su colaboración. Así, ha subrayado que la jueza ha actuado en el “ejercicio de sus funciones constitucionales”. “Todos debemos mostrar el máximo respeto”, ha añadido.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/marlaska-traslada-al-poder-judicial-su-preocupacion-por-la-decision-de-la-jueza-tardon-de-prohibir-a-la-policia-informarle-sobre-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Marlaska se queja ante el Poder Judicial de que la jueza pidiera a la Policía no informarle sobre Ceuta

articles.body: <p>Una mujer ceutí ha sido detenida este jueves como presunta responsable del homicidio con arma blanca de <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/crisis-migratoria/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/crisis-migratoria/">un migrante en situación irregular en Ceuta</a>, según han confirmado a EL PAÍS fuentes policiales. Estas mismas fuentes señalan que el hombre estaba alojado en la casa de la detenida, donde han ocurrido los hechos, y que “supuestamente” era su primo. Las primeras investigaciones indican que la mujer detenida tiene antecedentes de problemas de salud mental diagnosticados y de consumo de sustancias, según han informado fuentes conocedoras del caso.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/detenida-una-mujer-ceuti-por-el-homicidio-de-un-migrante-en-situacion-irregular.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: Detenida una mujer ceutí por el homicidio de un migrante en situación irregular

articles.body: <p>La Comisión Europea sigue considerando a Marruecos un “socio estratégico importante” en materia de política migratoria, “particularmente en la lucha contra el tráfico de migrantes y la migración ilegal”, según ha subrayado un portavoz comunitario en Bruselas este jueves, mientras en el debate en el Congreso en Madrid varios líderes de la oposición señalaban a Rabat tras <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/ultima-hora-de-la-entrada-de-inmigrantes-a-ceuta-en-directo.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/ultima-hora-de-la-entrada-de-inmigrantes-a-ceuta-en-directo.html">la crisis en Ceuta. </a></p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/bruselas-sigue-considerando-a-marruecos-un-socio-estrategico-importante-de-la-ue.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>Pedro Sánchez ha dado un <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-31/sanchez-destaca-la-cooperacion-instantanea-con-marruecos-y-asegura-que-el-rey-visitara-ceuta.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-08-31/sanchez-destaca-la-cooperacion-instantanea-con-marruecos-y-asegura-que-el-rey-visitara-ceuta.html">giro a su discurso sobre Marruecos</a> en el debate en el Congreso sobre la crisis de Ceuta. El presidente ha admitido que entiende que muchos ciudadanos piensen que Rabat está detrás de la entrada masiva de migrantes, y no lo ha descartado completamente, pero asegura que de momento no tiene pruebas porque ningún servicio le ha planteado algo definitivo en este sentido, y por eso de momento está a la espera de que avancen las investigaciones. Sánchez ha recordado que una decisión de choque con Marruecos tendría graves consecuencias “sin marcha atrás”, y por eso para tomarla tiene que estar muy seguro.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-03/sanchez-si-existieran-pruebas-contra-marruecos-actuariamos-pero-no-hay-evidencias-solidas.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p><img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/UT2HCQ5PGNCNBES3WGL3LG5ETE.jpg?auth=ca1cbfd4e5d3d40e03f1610960e1f2cac1ceb1ed22c02478d92b3df0862c1f03" width="6000" height="4000" alt="El presidente del PP, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, da la réplica al discurso del presidente Sánchez este jueves en el Congreso. articles.body: (ACN) Aquest estiu ha estat el més càlid d’ençà que hi ha registres, unes altes temperatures a les quals també es pot atribuir una xifra rècord de defuncions: entre el juny i l’agost Catalunya ha registrat 1 . 835 morts per calor , segons dades del Sistema de Monitoratge de la Mortalitat Diària MoMo de l’Institut de Salut Carles III. Es tracta del màxim històric des que el centre de recerca recull dades, el 2015. De fet, aquest estiu pràcticament triplica el màxim anterior, que data de l’any passat, amb 669 persones . D’altra banda, amb dades del Sistema d’Informació per a la Vigilància d’Infeccions a Catalunya (SIVIC), 5.771 persones han estat ateses a l’atenció primària per efecte de la calor entre el maig i finals d’agost. A més, més de 2.000 persones han anat a urgències i 361 han estat hospitalitzades pel mateix motiu. La majoria de les morts atribuïbles a la calor són del mes d’agost , en concret, 1.164, cosa que també triplica la màxima de defuncions el vuitè mes de l’any fins ara, que data del 2018 (363). Bona part s’han concentrat en la tercera setmana del mes , entre els dies 15 i 22. Els rècords també s’han donat tant el mes de juny , amb 127 defuncions coincidint gairebé totes amb la primera onada de calor pels volts de Sant Joan, com el mes de juliol, amb 544 . Prop de 5.800 atesos pels efectes de la calor D’altra banda, l’ atenció primària ha atès 5.771 persones entre l’1 de maig i el 30 d’agost per efectes de la calor, en una estadística que es publica per primer cop aquest estiu. Més de la meitat han estat per insolacions i cops de calor (3.427), mentre que la deshidratació també ha estat un motiu de pes (1.806). Les síncopes de calor (64) són un motiu més minoritari per acudir al metge. Coincidint amb la segona onada d’altes temperatures, al voltant del 10 de juliol, es va registrar el pic de visites per la canícula, amb pràcticament mig miler en una setmana. Les urgències han atès 2.121 persones entre el maig i l’agost, la meitat de les quals per deshidratació. Les insolacions i els cops de calor són el motiu d’un terç de les visites, mentre que les síncopes protagonitzen una desena part dels casos. Les hospitalitzacions després d’acudir a urgències per la calor en aquest període s’han quedat en 361, la gran majoria dels quals per deshidratació .

articles.body: Néixer a Bristol marca la diferència, i el quartet Scaler n’és la prova evident. La banda recull l’esperit d’experimentació propi d’aquesta ciutat per fusionar trip-hop i drum’n’bass amb matisos de metal , noise, techno i drill , consolidant-se en la gran tradició local de creuar gèneres sense complexos. El seu darrer treball, Endlessly , ofereix una atmosfera fosca i d’una gran força addictiva. Més sobri i subtil que l’explosiu Void , el seu àlbum de debut, aquest disc —gravat a l’emblemàtica sala The Louisiana i editat pel segell independent Black Acre— demostra com el grup ha sabut assimilar les seves influències en lloc de replicar-les. En comptes de buscar l’impacte directe, els riffs s’articulen amb calma i precisió, generant una tensió constant a través de la repetició i el domini del ritme. Famosos per uns concerts de gran intensitat, la seva estrena al Sónar aquest 2026 és una de les cites que no convé perdre’s. articles.body: (ACN/Redacció) Futur incert per a la marca automobilística Seat , després que el Consell de Supervisió de Volkswagen ha aprovat per unanimitat el pla de reestructuració del grup automobilístic fins al 2030, segons ha informat el mateix consorci en un comunicat aquest dijous. Els ajustos inclouen la simplificació de l’estructura del grup i la retallada d’aproximadament 50.000 llocs de treball a tot el grup. El comunicat difós cita explícitament les plantes alemanyes d’Emden, Zwickau , Hannover i Neckarsulm i assegura que “no es pot garantir una assignació futura competitiva” entre el 2031 i el 2034. També et pot interessar Seat triplica el benefici operatiu fins als 122 milions d’euros el primer semestre de l’any Redacció 1 minut de lectura El pla també admet que la capacitat europea actual de producció supera la demanda en més de 500.000 unitats. Estipula que abans de finals de juny del 2027 “s’haurà de desenvolupar un concepte per a una estructura de producció sostenible i competitiva per a les plantes europees”. Tot i que no concreta, de moment, quina afectació pot tenir la marca Seat , el mitjà especialitzat alemany WirtschaftsWoche ha publicat que la marca, amb seu a Martorell, es retirarà del mercat el 2029 a tot estirar citant un document intern de la companyia automobilística. El cotxe elèctric i la competència de la Xina La irrupció del cotxe elèctric i l’aparició d’un competidor contundent com la Xina han impactat en el grup alemany, que amb aquesta reestructuració espera poder fer front al nou panorama. El comitè executiu impulsarà ara les mesures “necessàries” i afirma que ho farà “en col·laboració amb les marques, les filials i els representants dels treballadors”. Així, la firma considera essencial adaptar “de manera coherent” la capacitat de la plantilla a la “realitat econòmica”. Segons l’anàlisi en què es basa el Pla de futur 2030 , “serà necessari un ajustament de la plantilla d’aproximadament 50.000 llocs de treball a tot el grup, inclosos els càrrecs directius”. El pla estableix que el negoci automobilístic principal ha d’ocupar “el centre de l’estratègia”. Es preveuen unes vendes anuals de nou milions de vehicles “a mesura que evolucionin les condicions del mercat”, per bé que, ara com ara, el grup admet que la capacitat de producció excedeix en mig milió d’automòbils la demanda del mercat. Un altre pilar del pla de reestructuració és reduir un 50 % el catàleg de models i un 75 % la “complexitat de l’oferta” , alhora que es fan moviments per aconseguir una eficiència “significativament més elevada” i unes estructures directives “més simples” per actuar amb més rapidesa. També et pot interessar Seat comença la producció dels primers cotxes elèctrics a la planta de Martorell Redacció 3 minuts de lectura Missatge de cautela de Carnero Abans de començar la reunió, el president del Comitè d’Empresa de Seat i membre del consell de supervisió, Matías Carnero , ha enviat un missatge de cautela als treballadors després de la filtració del document i ha insistit en la necessitat de demanar una “segona plataforma” per assegurar l’ocupació i compensar el volum que es deixi de fer si no s’electrifiquen els models de Seat. El conseller delegat del Grup Volkswagen, Oliver Blume, ha celebrat l’aprovació per unanimitat de la reestructuració com un “senyal contundent” per al futur de la companyia i ha anunciat inversions milionàries durant els pròxims anys. També et pot interessar Seat desvela el Cupra Raval, el primer cotxe 100 % elèctric fet a la planta de Martorell Cristina Brotons 2 minuts de lectura

articles.body: El Gran Teatre del Liceu ha escollit la preestrena a Barcelona de Cronos , el thriller dramàtic que recrea l’operació policial que es va activar després de l’ atemptats a la Rambla i Cambrils el 17 d’agost de 2017 . Cronos és, de fet, el nom que va rebre aquest dispositiu dels Mossos d’Esquadra. A la projecció hi ha assistit l’equip del film, autoritats, convidats i personalitats del món de la cultura i la societat. La pel·lícula, dirigida per Fernando González Molina , està protagonitzada per Enric Auquer , Mónica López i Diana Gómez . Completen el repartiment, entre d’altres, Pablo Derqui, Xavi Sáez, Joan Pedrola, Mima Riera, David Vert, José Pérez Ocaña  i  Israel Elejalde . Una cinta basada en fets reals, escrita per Alberto Marini a partir de la investigació dels periodistes Nacho Carretero i Arturo Lezcano , cosa que es nota en la profusió de detalls que apareixen a la història. “Evitar el que encara poden fer” El 17 d’agost del 2017, a quarts de cinc de la tarda i amb el centre de Barcelona ple a vessar, es va produir l’atropellament intencionat amb una furgoneta a la Rambla. Passada la mitjanit, un altre vehicle conduït per terroristes va irrompe a Cambrils. Aquests atacs i accions amb arma blanca van causar setze víctimes. Els va reivindicar una cèl·lula d’Estat Islàmic composta per 12 militants liderats per l’imam de Ripoll  Abdelbaki es Satty . “Cronos és un thriller dramàtic que intenta ser respectuós amb les víctimes” , segons Enric Auquer, “intenta fer reflexió sobre el que va quedar després d’aquell dia i de quina manera ens podem tornar a mirar tots a la cara i reconciliar els uns i els altres”. També et pot interessar Nou anys del 17-A: “És un record que porta noms i cognoms, rostres i històries de vida” Andrea Muñoz Pablo Mena 5 minuts de lectura Durant els dies següents, la policia va posar en marxa el dispositiu Cronos per capturar els responsables de l’atac “no només per allò que han fet, sinó també per allò que encara poden fer”, com expressa en un moment de la cinta el policia que encarna Enric Auquer. La pel·lícula ressegueix, des del punt de vista de les forces de l’ordre , les 124 hores de confusió, tensió i dolor posteriors al atacs. En aquest sentit, la feina dels intèrprets era posar-se a la pell dels policies que van investigar el cas i que van confrontar els terroristes: “Vaig descobrir la capacitat d’un mosso d’esquadra per fer la seva feina en un moment com aquell”, ha dit Auquer. Cronos   es va rodar durant vuit setmanes en diferentes localitzacions reals de Catalunya després de més de dos anys de recerca dels esmentats Carretero i Lezcano. El rodatge va comptar amb la col·laboració, evidentment, de les principals institucions implicades en l’operació, com Mossos d’Esquadra, Guàrdia Urbana de Barcelona, Bombers de Barcelona i el SEM. Cronos   és una producció de Nostromo Pictures, Beta Fiction Spain i Hogar Produccion AIE, en coproducció amb  3Cat . S’estrena aquest divendres 4 de setembre a nombroses sales de Barcelona.
articles.headline: Enric Auquer: “‘Cronos’ reflexiona sobre el 17-A i com ens podem reconciliar els uns amb els altres”

articles.body: La mort del conductor d’un camió aquest dijous a la ronda del Litoral suposa la dotzena víctima mortal en accident de trànsit a Barcelona aquest 2026. En comparació amb altres anys, aquesta xifra ja supera el registre d’11 persones mortes tant l’any 2024 com el 2025 als carrers de la ciutat. I tot i això a l’inici de setembre, quan encara queden quatre mesos per acabar l’any . També et pot interessar Mor el conductor d’un camió que ha bolcat a la ronda del Litoral Marta Casals Torres 2 minuts de lectura Tres morts en cotxe, furgoneta o camió Aquest 2026, tres persones han perdut la vida conduint vehicles de quatre rodes a Barcelona. A més del conductor de camió mort d’aquest dijous, les altres dues víctimes mortals es van produir en un mateix accident el 28 de juny passat a la cruïlla dels carrers de Pallars i Fluvià. En canvi, durant el 2025, cap conductor de cotxe, furgoneta o camió va morir en accident de trànsit a Barcelona, una dada que també es va repetir el 2017. També et pot interessar Dues víctimes mortals i un ferit greu en un accident provocat per un conductor temerari Núria Granados Sílvia Gutiérrez 3 minuts de lectura Nou víctimes entre els més vulnerables De les 12 víctimes del 2026, el col·lectiu amb més mortalitat són els motoristes , amb cinc conductors morts en circulació a la ciutat. El més recent va passar el 31 d’agost, quan un motorista va perdre la vida després de ser envestit per un altre vehicle al carrer d’Aribau. També et pot interessar Mor un motorista de 38 anys envestit per un cotxe en un accident al carrer d’Aribau Marta Casals Torres 2 minuts de lectura A més dels motoristes, els altres col·lectius més vulnerables en els sinistre són els ciclistes i els vianants . Malauradament, aquest any també s’han comptabilitzat víctimes en diferents sinistres: un ciclista va morir en un accident de circulació i tres vianants van ser atropellats mortalment mentre caminaven. També et pot interessar Accidents mortals a Barcelona: on i quan es produeixen els sinistres de trànsit a la ciutat? | MAPA Eva Vial 4 minuts de lectura “Alguna cosa està fallant” L’associació Stop Accidents posa el focus en evitar el consum d’alcohol al volant, respectar la velocitat i no parlar amb el mòbil a la mà mentre es condueix. Marilina Ferrer , directora i psicòloga de l’entitat, considera que “ alguna cosa està fallant ” quan es produeixen aquestes xifres de sinistralitat mortal. “És una feina de tothom , també de les administracions, trobar el que falla”, assenyala. Des de l’entitat s’insisteix que tots els conductors han de complir les normes de circulació per aconseguir un trànsit segur . “El problema ve quan algun conductor les incompleix i es provoquen totes aquestes situacions dramàtiques a les carreteres”, conclou. També et pot interessar Les víctimes d’accident de trànsit ja poden demanar telemàticament l’informe pericial extrajudicial Eva Vial Redacció 1 minut de lectura 86 % menys de víctimes respecte al 1990 Des del 2015, la xifra de morts en accident de trànsit a Barcelona situa per sota de les 30 víctimes mortals anuals . Es tracta d’una xifra molt alta, tot i que molt lluny dels registres de principis dels 90 del segle passat, quan se superaven les 80 víctimes mortals anuals (entre 1990 i 1992). L’evolució d’aquests últims 35 anys marca una clara tendència a la baixa, amb una reducció del 86 % de sinistralitat mortal. Tot i això, en cap any no s’ha aconseguit baixar mai de la desena de víctimes anuals. També et pot interessar Ets testimoni d’un accident avui? Explica-ho a betevé Redacció 1 minut de lectura 87 morts en els primers vuit mesos a Catalunya Les xifres de Barcelona contrasten amb el balanç de la sinistralitat a Catalunya. Fins a finals d’agost 87 persones han perdut la vida en 83 accidents mortals a les carreteres catalanes , un 11 % menys que en el mateix període de l’any passat. En concret, durant el passat mes d’agost van morir cinc persones a la xarxa viària, quan el passat any en van ser 10. De les 87 víctimes mortals, 34 eren motoristes, 10 corresponien a ciclistes i cinc a vianants , que repeteixen com els col·lectius més vulnerables. Quant als ferits greus, enguany se n’han registrat 490, una xifra inferior als 601 del mateix període de l’any passat, amb una reducció del 18,5 %. articles.body: Queda menys d’una setmana per l’inici del curs escolar — marcat per la vaga del dia 8 de setembre — i des de la CGT denuncien que un 23 % del personal d’atenció educativa del sistema educatiu públic català encara no té contracte . Una situació que afecta, principalment, educadors d’educació especia l (EEE), tècnics d’integració social (TIS) i tècnics especialistes d’educació infantil (TEEI). També et pot interessar El curs començarà amb vaga a les escoles: fracassa el darrer intent per evitar-la Andrea Muñoz Maria Solans 2 minuts de lectura Errors i lentitud administrativa La CGT ha alertat d’aquesta situació després que diversos concursos de trasllat s’hagin publicat amb errades en les puntuacions i que això, a l’hora de calcular els mèrits, ha provocat un endarreriment en l’assignació definitiva. Unes equivocacions que, diuen, afegides a la lentitud burocràtica , situen bona part dels centres educatius sense uns equips definits a molt pocs dies d’iniciar el curs escolar. Martha Lozano, delegada de la CGT del personal laboral, assenyala que el 23 % de la plantilla va patir un cessament del seu contracte laboral en data 31 d’agost, quan finalitzava el seu contracte: “Havien d’encadenar-lo amb el contracte corresponent al curs actual, i no tenen clar quan podran reincorporar-se a la feina ni en quines condicions”, explica Lozano. També et pot interessar El nou curs escolar 2026-27, a punt: més professors, rècord d’aules d’acollida i límits a la IA Redacció 3 minuts de lectura 530 noves dotacions, a partir del dia 7 A banda, el sindicat alerta que les 530 noves dotacions anunciades pel Departament no estaran en marxa fins al 7 de setembre : “Amb la manca de treball i de salari que això comporta per a les treballadores, però també per als centres, que no disposaran d’aquesta figura fins al dia abans de començar el curs escolar”. Des de la CGT reclamen “més seriositat i respecte” per un col·lectiu que “ha estat històricament menyspreat i maltractat laboralment”. articles.body: Josep Maria Gené deixa la direcció esportiva de l’ Europa , però continuarà sent l’entrenador del primer equip. El club gracienc ha decidit reorganitzar les funcions dins de l’àrea esportiva després de l’inici de temporada i Gené deixarà de compaginar la banqueta amb les tasques de planificació esportiva. D’aquesta manera, el tècnic podrà centrar-se exclusivament en la direcció de l’equip, que afronta el seu segon curs consecutiu a Primera Federació. Josep Maria Gené deixa la direcció esportiva per centrar-se en el primer equip Un cop tancat el mercat de fitxatges, Josep Maria Gené deixa la direcció esportiva del CE Europa per centrar-se exclusivament en la seva funció com a entrenador del primer equip masculí. Més… — Club Esportiu Europa (@CEEuropa) September 3, 2026 Una decisió que ja estava presa La decisió ja estava presa abans de tota l’activitat d’aquest mercat de fitxatges i respon a una planificació interna del club. Gené continuarà al capdavant de l’equip com a entrenador, mentre que l’Europa haurà de definir ara qui assumeix les funcions de la direcció esportiva. De fet, el club gracienc ha comunicat que farà saber el seu substituit en les properes hores.
